EXPLANATION: The strong band at 2271 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a nitrile ν(C≡N); 1748 cm⁻¹ matches an ester carbonyl ν(C=O), and the absence of an O–H stretch rules out the hydroxy ester (candidate 2). The intense aliphatic C–H stretches at 2941/2981/2888 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1458/1403 cm⁻¹ are consistent with an alkyl ester (GFQ-003). Mid-frequency bands (∼1032, 1116, 1214, 1306 cm⁻¹) fit C–O stretching in ester/ether groups, and 855/922 cm⁻¹ are compatible with ethyl group rocking/wagging, supporting CCOC(=O)CC#N.
